SELECT t.id AS id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.case_id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, t.image_file_id AS imageFileId, i.original_filename AS originalFilename, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, t.priority AS priority, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.max_retry_count AS maxRetryCount, t.error_message AS errorMessage, t.submitted_by AS submittedBy, u.real_name AS submittedByName, t.submitted_at AS submittedAt, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.finished_at AS finishedAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM analysis_task t LEFT JOIN medical_case c ON c.id = t.case_id LEFT JOIN image_file i ON i.id = t.image_file_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.submitted_by
ORDER BY t.submitted_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT t.id AS id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.case_id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, t.image_file_id AS imageFileId, i.original_filename AS originalFilename, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, t.priority AS priority, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.max_retry_count AS maxRetryCount, t.error_message AS errorMessage, t.submitted_by AS submittedBy, u.real_name AS submittedByName, t.submitted_at AS submittedAt, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.finished_at AS finishedAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM analysis_task t LEFT JOIN medical_case c ON c.id = t.case_id LEFT JOIN image_file i ON i.id = t.image_file_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.submitted_by WHERE t.id = #{taskId}
